provenance.note: Event facts are validated; any stored profile is deliberately unused, not verified. A saved result's hash does not authenticate a remote provider call.

semantics: One training prefix is frozen for all held-out rounds; this is not the rolling online comparison. Probabilities condition on choosing a card, exclude STOP, and score the first finally-kept card. Empty choices and fewer than two eligible cards are unscored. Eligibility may use whole-round cumulative visibility. These are descriptive single-journal results, not a human-accuracy or display-policy claim. Semantic Jev input additionally supplies scene/motif descriptions; numeric input shares nine features.
